# units/day

> n day: days: 24 hours, as nanoseconds.

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/day.pkg)

```
print 2 day    // 172800000000000
```

Binds tighter than any operator, so `2 * 3 day` is `2 * (3 day)`.
See [units](../units.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{n: expr int} day -> int
```

|---|---|---|
| `n` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
